title: Atlas local runtime deterministic derivation and scoped lifecycle integration
uncertainty: Can one accepted real deterministic regional method and its dependency closure move from research orchestration into reusable runtime interfaces while preserving immutable output, qualified lineage, selective lifecycle and coherent historical publication?
importance: The first runtime operates retained publications; it does not yet execute or coordinate scientific processing. This is the next concrete gap toward a usable local workflow.
prerequisites: accepted local architecture and first runtime
unchanged retained inputs and accepted regional derivation methods
accepted dependency/lifecycle and multi-region publication contracts
scope: one existing deterministic terrain-derived method and one downstream accepted summary on bounded retained regional inputs
minimal isolated component-publication coordinator using accepted full guards
pinned runtime queries and historical replay
no generic ingestion/orchestration platform or production changes
deliverable: A documented runtime processing vertical slice with focused oracle, interruption and replay tests; no new physical source or scientific algorithm.
acceptance: real retained method reproduces accepted full derivation
exact affected closure and unchanged regional reuse
new and old pins query coherent source/output states after restart
stop: Stop after this one processing/lifecycle vertical slice is measured, tested, documented and committed; do not begin wider ingestion, runtime migration or service work.
